avp.configuration.title: AliensVsPredator Settings
avp.configuration.rendering.tooltip: How blocks and models look on your screen
avp.configuration.fernBrightness.tooltip: Multiplies the colour of Paradisian ferns. 1.0 = the original colours; raise it if ferns look too dark.
avp.configuration.showCopiedTextures.too: Show the copied block texture on slopes, corners, ridges and pyramids.
avp.configuration.blocks.tooltip: Gameplay rules for the mod's blocks
avp.configuration.shapesCanCopyBlocks.to: Players can right-click slopes, corners, ridges and pyramids with a block to copy its look.
avp.configuration.trophiesCanBeTipped.to: Players can right-click the Giger alien head to lay it flat or tilt it.
avp.configuration.trophySize.tooltip: Size of placed skulls, biomasks and heads. 1.0 = normal; 2.0 = twice as big.
avp.configuration.lockersCanHide.tooltip: Sneak + right-click a locker with an empty hand to hide inside it; sneak to get out.
avp.configuration.power.tooltip: How lights and machines get their power
avp.configuration.machinesNeedPower.tool: Lights and machines only work when powered. Turn off to have them always on.
avp.configuration.redstonePowersMachines: A redstone signal also powers lights and machines (no FE needed).
avp.configuration.lightEnergyPerTick.too: FE a light panel or fluorescent light uses per tick while on.
avp.configuration.cryostasisTubeEnergyPe: FE a cryostasis tube uses per tick to keep its contents frozen.
avp.configuration.medpodEnergyPerTick.to: FE a medpod uses per tick while powered.
avp.configuration.medpod.tooltip: How the medpod treats whoever is inside
avp.configuration.medpodHealInterval.too: Ticks between heals while inside a closed, powered medpod (20 ticks = 1 second).
avp.configuration.medpodHealAmount.toolt: Health restored each time (2 = one heart).
avp.configuration.medpodCuresEffects.too: The medpod also removes harmful effects like poison and wither.
avp.configuration.medpodBoost.tooltip: Getting out after a treatment gives a short golden-apple-style boost (Regeneration II + Absorption).
avp.configuration.medpodBoostMinTicks.to: How long you must stay in a closed, powered medpod to get the boost (20 ticks = 1 second).
avp.configuration.medpodRegenerationTick: How long the Regeneration II lasts (golden apple: 100 = 5 seconds).
How long the Absorption lasts (golden apple: 2400 = 2 minutes).
After getting out, the medpod won't take you back in for this many ticks (20 = 1 second).
avp.configuration.medpodEjectStrength.to: How hard you're pushed out of the medpod when you get out (0 = no push).
message.avp.blastdoor.no_power: The blast door has no power.
message.avp.blastdoor.wrong_tuner: This tuner isn't bound to this door.
message.avp.blastdoor.jack_only_unpowere: The Maintenance Jack only works on closed doors with no power.
message.avp.blastdoor.cannot_pry: Blast doors can't be pried open on this world.
screen.avp.blastdoor.title: Blast Door %s
screen.avp.blastdoor.admin_help: Only bound tuners can manage a bound door.
tooltip.avp.maintenancejack: Forces open blast doors that have no power.
avp.configuration.blastDoorEnergyPerTick: FE a blast door uses per tick while powered.
avp.configuration.blastDoorAutolockTicks: With Auto-Lock on, an unlocked door closes and locks again after this many ticks (20 = 1 second).
avp.configuration.blastDoorsCanBePried.t: Unpowered blast doors can be forced partly open with a Maintenance Jack.
avp.configuration.doorSensorRange.toolti: How far (in blocks) a door's sensors reach: Auto-Open and Threat Detection.
avp.configuration.doorAutoCloseTicks.too: Auto-Open closes the door this many ticks after the last player left (20 = 1 second).
message.avp.powerline.too_big: This network has over %s powerlines - too big to carry power (see settings)
message.avp.power.no_fuel: no fuel (right-click with coal, wood, a lava bucket...)
avp.configuration.redstoneEmitterEnergyP: FE a redstone emitter uses per tick while it gives a redstone signal.
avp.configuration.satelliteDishEnergyPer: FE a satellite dish uses per tick while powered.
avp.configuration.powerNetwork.tooltip: Generators, transformers, power cells and powerlines
avp.configuration.solarPanelOutput.toolt: FE per tick at noon in clear weather (less morning, evening and in rain; none at night).
avp.configuration.generatorOutput.toolti: FE per tick while it burns fuel.
avp.configuration.generatorFuelMultiplie: How long fuel lasts compared to a furnace (1.0 = same as a furnace).
avp.configuration.repulsionOutputPerMagn: FE per tick for each neodymium magnet inside (up to 8).
avp.configuration.transformerRate.toolti: Most FE per tick a transformer passes from its back to its front.
avp.configuration.stepdownTransformerRat: Most FE per tick a step-down transformer passes.
avp.configuration.powercellCapacity.tool: How much FE a power cell stores.
avp.configuration.powercellRate.tooltip: Most FE per tick a power cell gives out (and takes in).
avp.configuration.maxCableNetworkSize.to: Networks with more connected powerlines than this carry no power (limits lag).
avp.configuration.teslaCoil.tooltip: How tesla coils defend an area
avp.configuration.teslaCoilEnergyPerTick: FE a tesla coil uses per tick while switched on.
Extra FE used each time it strikes a creature.
avp.configuration.teslaCoilRange.tooltip: How far a tesla coil can strike.
avp.configuration.teslaCoilTargetsPlayer: Also strike players (never in creative or spectator mode).
avp.configuration.teslaCoilSetsFire.tool: Strikes set the target on fire for a few seconds.
message.avp.assembler.missing: You don't have all the materials.
message.avp.assembler.no_power: Not enough power (needs %s FE per item).
FE a terminal uses per tick while its screen is on.
avp.configuration.assemblerEnergyPerItem: FE the Assembler uses for each item it makes (0 = no power needed).
avp.configuration.lithiumReactsWithWater: Lithium ingots explode when they touch water (carried or dropped).
message.avp.power.array: making %s FE/t - array of %s panels, %s wired
message.avp.power.array_unwired: making %s FE/t - array of %s panels, none wired (connect a powerline to any panel)
message.avp.power.bank: giving %s FE/t - bank of %s cells: %s / %s FE
tooltip.avp.solarpanel:
Weyland-Yutani SC-7 photovoltaic panel.
Touching panels form an array: wire one and the whole array feeds it.
tooltip.avp.universalgenerator:
W-Y universal combustion generator.
Burns almost anything. Standard issue on frontier colonies.
tooltip.avp.generator:
Magnetic repulsion generator.
Neodymium magnets spin on frictionless bearings: no fuel, no exhaust.
tooltip.avp.transformer:
W-Y grid transformer. Power flows from back to front.
Sneak + right-click to turn it.
tooltip.avp.transformer_stepdown: Step-down transformer: limits the flow to protect delicate equipment.
tooltip.avp.powercell:
W-Y lithium-matrix power cell.
Cells that touch, or share a powerline, balance their charge.
tooltip.avp.powerline:
Insulated W-Y power conduit.
Carries power instantly to every connected device.
tooltip.avp.redstonesensor: Grid isolation switch: passes power only while it gets a redstone signal.
tooltip.avp.redstoneemitter: Grid signal relay: gives a redstone signal while powered.
tooltip.avp.satellitedish: Long-range uplink dish for colony-to-orbit communications.
tooltip.avp.teslacoil:
Experimental W-Y perimeter defence.
Strikes hostile organisms in range. Do not touch.
tooltip.avp.terminal:
MU/TH/UR 6000 terminal.
Shows the status of the power grid it is wired to.
tooltip.avp.assembler:
W-Y automated fabricator: builds parts and equipment from raw materials.
Machines (AE2 pattern providers, Create, hoppers) can feed it and take results.
"Building Better Worlds."
tooltip.avp.cryo_coolant:
Hypersleep-grade cryogenic coolant.
Keeps a sleeper's metabolism near zero.
tooltip.avp.part_sensor_array: The sensor package from an M314 motion tracker.
tooltip.avp.part_servo: Precision servo motor, as used in Seegson's Working Joes.
tooltip.avp.ingot_lithium: Reacts violently with water. Keep dry.
tooltip.avp.blastdoor: Pressure-rated blast door. Program it with a Security Tuner.
tooltip.avp.turret:
UA 571-C automated sentry gun.
IFF: never fires on its owner or the owner's team.
Place under a ceiling to hang it upside down.
tooltip.avp.ammo_sentry: Standard 10x28mm caseless rounds for UA 571 sentry guns.
death.attack.avp.sentry: %1$s was cut down by a sentry gun
death.attack.avp.sentry.player: %1$s was cut down by a sentry gun while fighting %2$s
message.avp.turret.not_owner: Only %s can change this turret's targets.
avp.configuration.turret.tooltip: Range, damage, rate of fire and ammo
avp.configuration.turretEnergyPerTick.to: FE a sentry turret uses per tick while switched on.
avp.configuration.turretRange.tooltip: How far a sentry turret sees and shoots.
avp.configuration.turretRangePerSensor.t: Extra range for each Motion Sensor Array upgrade.
avp.configuration.turretFireInterval.too: Ticks between shots (2 = 10 shots a second).
avp.configuration.turretRoundsPerBox.too: Rounds in one Sentry Ammo Box.
avp.configuration.turretTurnSpeed.toolti: How fast it turns; each Processor upgrade adds half again.
avp.configuration.turretBypassesInvulner: Shots ignore the short invulnerability after a hit (like 1.12.2).
avp.configuration.worldgen.tooltip: Which ores generate in new chunks (restart needed)
avp.configuration.generateOres.tooltip: Generate AvP ores in new chunks. Restart needed.
avp.configuration.ore_bauxite.tooltip: Generate bauxite ore in new chunks.
avp.configuration.ore_copper.tooltip: Generate copper ore in new chunks.
avp.configuration.ore_silicon.tooltip: Generate silicon ore in new chunks.
avp.configuration.ore_monazite.tooltip: Generate monazite ore in new chunks.
avp.configuration.ore_lithium.tooltip: Generate lithium ore in new chunks.
avp.configuration.ore_cobalt.tooltip: Generate cobalt ore in new chunks.
tooltip.avp.ammo_sentry_ap:
Cobalt-cored armour-piercing rounds: ignore armour.
Issued for engagements with hardened xenomorph chitin.
tooltip.avp.ammo_sentry_incendiary: Incendiary rounds: set targets on fire.
death.attack.avp.acid.player: %1$s was burned by acid blood while fighting %2$s
death.attack.avp.chestburster: %1$s had something burst out of their chest
death.attack.avp.chestburster.player: %1$s had something burst out of their chest
message.avp.medpod.embryo_too_late: Foreign organism too developed for removal.
How long a facehugger stays on its host (20 ticks = 1 second).
avp.configuration.facehuggerLifetimeAfte: How long a spent facehugger lies on its back before dying.
avp.configuration.facehuggerHelmetMelt.t: Durability a lunge takes off a helmet; it only latches on once the helmet breaks.
avp.configuration.acidBloodDamage.toolti: Damage to the host when an attached facehugger is hurt (0 = off).
avp.configuration.facehuggersTargetPlaye: Facehuggers go after players (never creative or spectator).
avp.configuration.embryoGestationTicks.t: How long an embryo grows before it bursts out (20 ticks = 1 second).
avp.configuration.embryoSymptoms.tooltip: Hosts feel sick (nausea, weakness, hunger) near the end.
avp.configuration.medpodRemovesEmbryo.to: A powered, closed medpod removes an embryo unless it's nearly grown.
avp.configuration.naturalSpawns.tooltip: AvP creatures spawn naturally. Restart needed.
avp.configuration.spawn_facehugger.toolt: Facehuggers spawn in jungles, swamps and dark forests (in the dark).
tooltip.avp.facehugger_spawn_egg:
Xenomorph parasitoid, first stage.
"It's got a wonderful defence mechanism."
avp.configuration.chestbursterMatureTick: How long a chestburster takes to grow into a Drone (64 royal jelly does it at once).
tooltip.avp.chestburster_spawn_egg:
Xenomorph, second stage.
Grows into a Drone (when the Drone is ported).
How long a hatched egg stays before it withers away.
tooltip.avp.ovamorph_spawn_egg:
Xenomorph egg. Opens when a host comes near.
"Kane, don't touch it!"
tooltip.avp.specimen_container:
Weyland-Yutani biological containment unit.
Use on a shut Ovamorph to capture it.
"Priority one: ensure return of organism for analysis."
tooltip.avp.contained_ovamorph:
A live Ovamorph, sealed and dormant.
Use on a block to release it, or store it in a cryostasis tube.
message.avp.specimen.opening: It's opening - too late to contain it!
message.avp.cryotube.occupied: This tube already holds a specimen.
message.avp.cryotube.broken: The glass is shattered - repair it with Industrial Glass.
message.avp.cryotube.empty: Empty. Use a contained specimen on it to store it here.
message.avp.cryotube.frozen: Specimen in stasis. Royal jelly is collected over time.
message.avp.cryotube.thawing: WARNING: no power - the specimen is thawing!
avp.configuration.cryotubeHarvestTicks.t: A frozen specimen in a powered tube gives one royal jelly this often.
avp.configuration.cryotubeThawTicks.tool: How long a tube can lose power before the specimen breaks out.
avp.configuration.creatures.tooltip: Size, acid blood and growing up
avp.configuration.filmAccurateSizes.tool: New creatures spawn at their film size (bigger adult Xenomorphs) instead of the classic size.
avp.configuration.xenoAcidSplashDamage.t: Damage to whoever hits a Xenomorph up close (0 = off).
avp.configuration.xenoAcidWeaponDamage.t: Durability acid blood eats off the weapon that hit a Xenomorph (0 = off).
avp.configuration.droneMatureTicks.toolt: How long a Drone takes to become a Warrior (once the Warrior is ported).
avp.configuration.spawn_drone.tooltip: Drones spawn in jungles, swamps and dark forests (in the dark).
tooltip.avp.drone_spawn_egg:
Xenomorph XX121, adult drone.
"I admire its purity."
avp.configuration.xenoHungerDrainTicks.t: Xenomorphs have a hidden hunger meter (0-100) that drops by 1 this often.
avp.configuration.xenoHungryBelow.toolti: Below this they hunt animals and creatures for food; above it they leave them alone unless attacked.
avp.configuration.xenosAlwaysHuntPlayers: Hunt players even when full (people are hosts and threats, not food). Off: only when hungry or attacked.
avp.configuration.xenosStarve.tooltip: With an empty hunger meter they slowly lose health.
avp.configuration.smartXenomorphs.toolti: Senses, investigating, stalking, flanking, retreating and learning. Off: simple 1.12.2 AI.
avp.configuration.xenoHearingRange.toolt: Sprinting or fighting is heard this far; walking at half, sneaking at a quarter.
avp.configuration.xenoSightRange.tooltip: How far they spot a player in plain view; sneaking players at a third.
avp.configuration.xenosRetreatWhenHurt.t: Badly hurt or burning Xenomorphs pull back into the dark.
avp.configuration.xenosRegenerate.toolti: Out of combat, Xenomorphs slowly heal.
avp.configuration.xenosBreakLights.toolt: They sometimes smash torches and lanterns to make it darker.
avp.configuration.xenosBreakDoors.toolti: They can smash through wooden doors (iron and blast doors stop them).
avp.configuration.xenosLearnTurrets.tool: Shot by a sentry turret, they remember it, warn the others and keep out of its range.
avp.configuration.xenosAcidBreach.toolti: Stuck behind an iron door, they wound a packmate so its acid blood melts through (Alien Resurrection).
avp.configuration.acidMeltAmount: Acid Needed to Melt a Door
avp.configuration.acidMeltAmount.tooltip: Damage dealt to bleeding Xenomorphs next to a door before it melts.
avp.configuration.acidBreachInterval.too: How often a Xenomorph wounds its packmate while melting a door.
avp.configuration.xenosBreakGlass.toolti: They smash glass blocks and panes between them and their prey.
avp.configuration.xenosCrawl.tooltip: They drop to a crawl to squeeze through vents and 1-block-high gaps.
avp.configuration.xenoDebugLabels.toolti: Show what each Xenomorph is doing above its head (for testing).
With no other way to their prey, they tear through the blocks in the way.
avp.configuration.xenoDigMaxHardness.too: Stone 1.5, iron block 5, obsidian 50. Blocks in avp:xeno_unbreakable are always safe.
avp.configuration.xenoDigSpeed.tooltip: 1.0 = about a stone pickaxe on stone.
avp.configuration.xenoPacks.tooltip: Nearby Xenomorphs form packs: a leader, shared targets and knowledge, bolder in numbers.
avp.configuration.xenoPackRange.tooltip: How close they must be to join or alert a pack.
tooltip.avp.warrior_spawn_egg: The hive's soldier. Grown from a Drone that fed well.
tooltip.avp.praetorian_spawn_egg: The Queen's guard. Given enough royal jelly, one may become a Queen.
tooltip.avp.matriarch_spawn_egg: The Queen. Lays eggs while well fed; every Xenomorph nearby comes when she calls.
tooltip.avp.crusher_spawn_egg: Armoured head-plate, bred from the Runner line. Charges and bowls its prey over.
tooltip.avp.spitter_spawn_egg: Grown in a llama or witch. Spits acid from a distance.
tooltip.avp.boiler_spawn_egg: Grown in a creeper. Swollen with acid; bursts over its prey.
tooltip.avp.runner_drone_spawn_egg: A four-legged Runner, grown in a beast. Fast, and climbs anything.
tooltip.avp.runner_warrior_spawn_egg: A grown Runner. Feed it enough and it becomes a Crusher.
tooltip.avp.nauticomorph_spawn_egg: Grown in a squid or guardian. Hunts in the water.
tooltip.avp.predalien_spawn_egg: Born from a Yautja. Plants embryos straight into its victims with its bite.
tooltip.avp.ultramorph_spawn_egg: Born from an Engineer. Huge, pale and terribly strong.
tooltip.avp.bat_xenomorph_spawn_egg: Grown in a bat. Hunts from the air.
tooltip.avp.pantheramorph_spawn_egg: Grown in an ocelot. A pouncing hunter.
tooltip.avp.myceliomorph_spawn_egg: Grown in a mooshroom. Its claws carry spores.
tooltip.avp.belugamorph_spawn_egg: Grown in a dolphin. Pale and at home in the deep.
tooltip.avp.dracomorph_spawn_egg: Born from the Ender Dragon. A winged nightmare.
tooltip.avp.deacon_spawn_egg: The Deacon: what comes out of an Engineer carrying a Trilobite's embryo.
tooltip.avp.royal_facehugger_spawn_egg: Carries a Queen embryo. Big enough to fight its way to a host.
tooltip.avp.octohugger_spawn_egg: Hangs from ceilings and drops onto passing hosts.
tooltip.avp.trilobite_spawn_egg: The giant facehugger from the Prometheus. Its embryo becomes a Deacon.
tooltip.avp.ovamorph_giger_spawn_egg: An egg as H.R. Giger first drew it.
tooltip.avp.yautja_warrior_spawn_egg: Hunts only worthy prey: Xenomorphs, the armed and the dangerous. Cloaks while it stalks.
tooltip.avp.yautja_berserker_spawn_egg: An outcast that has given up the honour code. Hunts anything.
tooltip.avp.marine_spawn_egg: USCM Colonial Marine. On your side - fires on Xenomorphs on sight.
tooltip.avp.combat_synthetic_spawn_egg: Weyland-Yutani combat synthetic. Fearless, and no use to a facehugger.
tooltip.avp.engineer_spawn_egg: A Space Jockey out of its suit. Leaves you alone - until you strike it.
tooltip.avp.space_jockey_spawn_egg: An Engineer in its biomechanical suit.
tooltip.avp.goo_mutant_spawn_egg: What the black goo leaves of a man.
tooltip.avp.aethon_spawn_egg: A great winged beast of the Engineers' worlds.
tooltip.avp.scelemur_spawn_egg: A Varda tree-climber. Bites if you corner it.
tooltip.avp.ursuidae_spawn_egg: A Varda boar. Leave it be.
tooltip.avp.hammerpede_spawn_egg: Lives in black goo. Its bite is venomous.
tooltip.avp.yautja_mutant_spawn_egg: A Yautja ruined by the black goo.
tooltip.avp.predator_hound_spawn_egg: A Yautja hunting beast. Tracks down Xenomorphs.
tooltip.avp.chestburster_queen_spawn_egg: A Royal Facehugger's embryo: a future Queen.
tooltip.avp.chestburster_runner_spawn_eg: Born from a beast; grows into a Runner.
message.avp.implanted: Something has been planted inside you...
avp.configuration.queenEggTicks.tooltip: A well-fed Queen lays an egg this often while she isn't fighting (up to 12 nearby).
avp.configuration.yautjaHonourCode.toolt: Yautja only hunt worthy prey: Xenomorphs, dangerous monsters and armed or armoured players.
avp.configuration.yautjaCloak.tooltip: Yautja cloak while stalking; other creatures lose track of them.
avp.configuration.marinesAlliedToPlayers: Marines and synthetics follow players and only turn on one that attacks them.
avp.configuration.marineRifleDamage.tool: Damage of each round a Marine fires (3-round bursts).
message.avp.cocoon_freed: You cut the host free of the resin.
avp.configuration.hives.tooltip: Drones found hives deep underground, coat them in resin and bring hosts back alive.
avp.configuration.hiveSpacing.tooltip: Only one hive within this distance; Xenomorphs in range join it instead of starting another.
avp.configuration.hiveRadius.tooltip: How far a hive with a Queen grows from its core. Without a Queen it stays a small nest.
avp.configuration.resinBuildSpeed.toolti: How fast Drones spread resin (0 = never).
avp.configuration.resinCoversBuiltBlocks: Resin may coat player-built blocks too. Off: only natural ground (avp:resin_coverable).
avp.configuration.xenosCocoonHosts.toolt: Drones carry worn-down animals and villagers back to the hive and cocoon them for the eggs.
avp.configuration.royalSuccession.toolti: A hive without a Queen feeds royal jelly from every kill to an heir until it grows into a Queen.
avp.configuration.eggmorphing.tooltip: Cocooned hosts slowly turn into eggs, so a hive can spread without a Queen.
avp.configuration.eggmorphTicks.tooltip: How long a cocooned host takes to become an egg (24000 = one day).
message.avp.captured: A Drone has you! It's dragging you away...
message.avp.cocooned: You're cocooned in the hive wall. Mash SNEAK to struggle free - they'll hear you.
message.avp.struggle: Cocooned - mash SNEAK to struggle free: %s%%
message.avp.broke_free: You tore free of the resin!
avp.configuration.xenosCocoonPlayers.too: Drones capture worn-down players: carried to the hive and held on the wall until they struggle free, are cut free or an egg opens.
avp.configuration.cocoonStruggles.toolti: How many sneak presses a cocooned player needs to tear free.
avp.configuration.hiveLarder.tooltip: Drones bring back prey that can't host as food; hungry members feed on it instead of hunting.
avp.configuration.hiveMaxDugBlocks.toolt: Most blocks one hive may dig out for its rooms and galleries.
avp.configuration.foundingDigSpeed.toolt: How much faster a Drone digs its founding tunnel (it won't hunt or hunger until the hive is made).
tooltip.avp.hivestone: Hardened resin and digested rock. Builder Drones lay hive floors, bridges and seals with it.
avp.configuration.biomaskNightVision.too: Wearing a Yautja biomask lets you see in the dark.
avp.configuration.resinCreepRate.tooltip: How fast resin in a living hive spreads by itself to neighbouring blocks (0 = never).
avp.configuration.hiveBuilders.tooltip: Builder Drones a founded hive keeps: worker Drones change into them when it's short.
avp.configuration.hiveCoaters.tooltip: Coater Drones a founded hive keeps: worker Drones change into them when it's short.
tooltip.avp.builder_drone_spawn_egg: A Drone that took up building for its hive: stocky and slow, it lays hivestone floors, bridges and seals.
tooltip.avp.coater_drone_spawn_egg: A Drone that took up coating the hive: lean and quick, always on the walls and ceilings spraying resin.
tooltip.avp.gun_m41a:
10mm caseless, 99 rounds, fully automatic.
"Check it out, I am the ultimate badass!"
tooltip.avp.gun_m56sg: 500 rounds; its targeting system steers rounds onto threats near the crosshair.
tooltip.avp.gun_sniper: Bolt action, 6 rounds, hits hard at long range.
tooltip.avp.ammo_ar: Fits the M41A, M4 and AK-47.
tooltip.avp.firearm.controls: Hold use to fire - sneak-use to reload
message.avp.no_ammo: Out of ammo - you need a %s
tooltip.avp.grenade_m40: Throw it, or press G with an M41A to fire it from the grenade launcher.
tooltip.avp.gun_m240icu: "Get away from her, you..." - burns creatures and hive resin.
tooltip.avp.gun_flamethrower_sevastopol: A maintenance flamethrower from Sevastopol Station. Shorter reach.
tooltip.avp.motiontracker:
Hold it to see anything moving in front of you, out to 30 metres.
"They're right on top of us!"
tooltip.avp.helm_marine: M10 pattern helmet. Its lamp lights up where you look in the dark.
tooltip.avp.helm_celtic: A biomask: see in the dark, and no facehugger can get at your face.
tooltip.avp.body_xeno: Full set: acid doesn't burn you.
tooltip.avp.flamethrower: Hold use to spray fire. Runs on propane tanks.
avp.configuration.grenadesBreakBlocks.to: Grenades blow up blocks (off: they only hurt creatures).
avp.configuration.flamethrowerIgnites.to: Flames set blocks alight where they land (they always burn hive resin).
avp.configuration.helmetLamp.tooltip: The Colonial Marine helmet lights up the dark where you look.
tooltip.avp.wristbracer: The Yautja's wrist computer. Carry it to cloak (C) or, as a last resort, self-destruct (K, twice).
tooltip.avp.smartdisc: Throw it: it slices through and comes back to your hand.
tooltip.avp.shuriken: A spinning throwing blade. Pick it up again after.
tooltip.avp.tool_celtic_spear: Hold use and let go to throw it.
tooltip.avp.plasmacaster: Hold use to charge, let go to fire. A full charge hits much harder.
message.avp.need_biomask: You need to be wearing a biomask
avp.configuration.selfDestruct.tooltip: The wristbracer's self-destruct can be armed (K, twice).
avp.configuration.selfDestructPower.tool: Explosion size (TNT is 4). Breaks blocks if mobGriefing is on.
tooltip.avp.stunbaton: A jolt that slows and weakens - for bringing one back alive.
tooltip.avp.supplychute: Calls down a supply drop where you stand (needs open sky).
tooltip.avp.supplychute_marines: Calls down a Colonial Marines supply drop: ammunition and grenades.
tooltip.avp.supplychute_seegson: Calls down a Seegson supply drop: tools and survival gear.
tooltip.avp.mine_laser: Use it on a wall: anything that breaks its beam sets it off. Hit it to take it down.
message.avp.supply_no_sky: The drop needs open sky above you
tooltip.avp.phial_empty: Fill it from a pool of black goo or an Engineer ampule (which might crack).
tooltip.avp.phial_goo: Pour it out on a block. Handle with care.
avp.configuration.blackGooMutation.toolt: Black goo mutates creatures in it (villagers -> goo mutants, silverfish -> Hammerpedes, livestock -> babyheads).
avp.configuration.ampuleLeakChance.toolt: Chance an Engineer ampule cracks and leaks each time a phial is filled from it.
